given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator has access to the zone management module
given_when_then.when: The operator creates a new polygon boundary for a delivery zone and publishes it
given_when_then.then: The system stores the new definition as the active version and invalidates the previous zone map

given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator modifies a Service Area Definition
given_when_then.when: The modification is saved and published
given_when_then.then: All modifications are logged with a timestamp and the identity of the Platform Operator

given_when_then.given: A Service Area Definition is modified
given_when_then.when: The system recalculates travel time matrices
given_when_then.then: The travel time matrices reflect updated route constraints

given_when_then.given: An Order Request is submitted for an address outside the active Service Area Definition
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine validates the order
given_when_then.then: The order is rejected and a rejection reason is logged

success_criteria: The system logs all modifications to Service Area Definitions with a timestamp and the identity of the Platform Operator.
The new version of a Service Area Definition supersedes the previous active version immediately upon publication.
The travel time matrices are recalculated whenever a Service Area Definition is modified to reflect updated route constraints.
Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition are rejected by the Order Allocation Engine.
A new version of a Service Area Definition is stored and the previous zone map is invalidated.
